headline_en: NVDA (ACCUMULATION) earnings loom as Taiwan indicts employee in AI server smuggling case

executive_bullets_en: Oil drops >3% on US pivot to economic sanctions on Iran, easing broad inflation pressure and supporting equity futures.
MU (ACCUMULATION) and ANET (ACCUMULATION) stand out as best technical opportunities in green macro regime with strong Stage2 scores.
NVDA (ACCUMULATION) earnings on 2026-08-27 and TSM (DOWNTREND) gap risk from Taiwan enforcement headlines are key event risks today.

MU (ACCUMULATION)와 ANET (ACCUMULATION)이 녹색 매크로 신호 속 기술적 기회로 가장 두드러짐.

big_picture.summary_en: Reports indicate Taiwan prosecutors indicted a Nvidia employee for smuggling advanced AI servers to China, directly pressuring NVDA (ACCUMULATION) and TSM (DOWNTREND) amid approaching semiconductor tariffs. Early reports suggest oil prices fell over 3% as the US shifted to economic sanctions on Iran, providing broad relief via lower input costs.
